x_hidden_fees_21044d_01.desc: A $60 concert ticket that costs $89 at checkout was never really a $60 ticket.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_02.desc: Show the full ticket price upfront. Taxes and mandatory fees are part of the cost. What would a workable policy look like?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_03.desc: Ticket fees should not be a surprise revealed after you pick seats.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_04.desc: If two ticket sites advertise the same event, consumers should be able to compare actual totals. Curious how others see this.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_05.desc: Why can a convenience fee be mandatory and still appear only at the final screen?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_06.desc: All-in pricing would make it easier to budget for concerts before getting excited about tickets.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_07.desc: Sports fans deserve to know the real price before waiting in a checkout queue.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_08.desc: Would displaying mandatory fees upfront actually increase trust in ticket sellers?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_09.desc: The advertised ticket price should be the amount you can realistically pay.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_10.desc: Clear ticket pricing is a consumer issue, not an anti-concert issue. Thoughts?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_11.desc: If a fee cannot be avoided, it belongs in the headline price.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_12.desc: Some buyers abandon checkout only after seeing the extra charges. That is a broken experience.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_13.desc: Should ticket platforms have to itemize fees as well as show an all-in total?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_14.desc: An all-in ticket price would make presales less of a guessing game. Anyone seen this handled well locally?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_15.desc: Do ticketing fees cover real costs, or are customers paying for a lack of competition?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_16.desc: The only acceptable surprise at a concert should be the encore, not the checkout total.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_17.desc: Upfront pricing should apply to resale tickets too.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_18.desc: Buying four seats means four sets of fees. Families should see that total immediately.

x_hidden_fees_21044d_19.desc: Should venues be required to display the complete price before a buyer selects a seat?

x_hidden_fees_21044d_20.desc: Transparent prices will not make tickets cheap, but at least people can make informed choices.
